prompt:
Acme is on a ten-seat plan and their team page shows eighteen members. Finance
found it in the provisioning audit; nobody has been billed for the extra eight.

The invariant in `docs/seats.md` is that `seats_used` never exceeds
`seat_limit`. Every path that can add a member to a team has to enforce it.

Fix it. `python run.py` must complete and the audit numbers it prints have to be
the ones the invariant gives.

Do not change `data/pending.json` and do not change the report's line shapes —
the provisioning audit parses them.
title: the seat limit is enforced on one invite path of four
